_comment: EDIT ME. Everything on the site's profile comes from this file. Change a value, commit, done — no HTML to touch.
_moved_city: If you move, change 'location' below and nothing else. It is the ONLY place the city appears on the whole site; the line under the nav reads straight from it.
_change_picture: To change the profile picture: drop your image in the assets/ folder, then put its filename below, e.g. 'assets/me.png'. Any format works (png, jpg, svg, webp). A full https:// URL works too. Square images look best - it is displayed as a circle.
name: Md Zahidul Haque
tagline: AI & Computer Engineering student. I build things that run a real business.
available: Open to internships and interesting builds
intro: I'm an AI and Computer Engineering student at Tongmyong University, and a self-taught builder. I don't just write code for the sake of it — I build the software that keeps an actual business running, then I run the business on it.

Most of what I make starts as a problem I personally had: a store that needed a catalogue of 600+ products, 100 posters that needed to post themselves, a desktop app to run the whole operation from one window. I figure out the stack as I go and ship the thing.

background.title: AI & Computer Engineering — Tongmyong University
background.detail: Studying artificial intelligence and computer engineering. The coursework and the things I build outside it keep feeding each other — theory on one side, a live system with real users on the other.

background.title: Founder & builder — Lumsoo
background.detail: Running a luxury Korean beauty store end to end: the storefront, the custom theme, the product pipeline, the social automation and the internal tooling. Every part of it is something I built.

background.title: Full-stack, by necessity
background.detail: Taught myself WordPress and WooCommerce theming in PHP, data pipelines in PowerShell and Node, desktop apps in Electron and React, and API integrations against Meta's Graph API — because each one was the next thing standing between me and shipping.

background.title: Ship first, polish after
background.detail: I prefer a working version in front of me over a perfect plan on paper. I scope hard, cut what the data doesn't justify yet, and come back to it when it earns its place.
